summary: Full e2e validation of new BHP feature (employees list + filters, BHP info update, document upload/list/download/delete, archive/restore, bulk-download zip+merged-pdf). 15/15 backend pytest cases pass (incl. edge: invalid category 400, >10MB 400, no docs 404, non-PDF merge 400, invalid format 400). Frontend Playwright verified: login -> BHP tab -> sub-tab 'Pracownicy - dokumenty' renders correctly, all data-testids present, multi-select activates 'Pobierz dokumenty (1)' button, modal shows 6 categories + ZIP/PDF format toggles, edit modal opens with all 7 BHP fields (job_title, registered_at, bhp_valid_until, height_work_certified, height_valid_until, save, upload_category, upload_input). BHP info save persisted (job_title=TEST_HookOperator confirmed via API). ClothingOrderPublic.js code-reviewed: no qty input, hardcoded quantity:1 in POST, button label 'Zamow 1 szt.' - meets spec.

No visual progress / spinner shown during PDF upload - user clicks 'Dodaj plik' and waits with no feedback. Minor UX nit; not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: bhp.py upload_document: 14MB threshold (line 286) is base64-string length, not decoded byte count. Comment/error says 'max 10MB' but actual limit is ~10.5MB decoded. Accurate but slightly misleading - acceptable.

bhp.py upload_document line 290-291: bare `except (ValueError, TypeError)` re-raises HTTPException via raise without `from` chaining; consider `raise HTTPException(...) from exc` for better tracebacks. Minor.

bhp.py bulk_download line 477: bare `except Exception: continue` silently swallows ALL pypdf errors - if a PDF is partially corrupted only some pages get included with no log entry. Consider logging skipped docs to help admin diagnose.

BhpEmployees.js: 600+ lines in a single file, includes filtering, list, modal, upload and download modals - candidate for splitting (BhpEmployeesList, BhpEmployeeEditModal, BhpBulkDownloadModal) per file-size guideline (>500 lines).

bhp.py archive_employee always sets currently_active=False and clears archived_at on restore - confirm this won't fight Excel sync that re-sets currently_active. Race condition possible but minor (sync runs on demand).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids found, edit modal save persisted via API)
